summary.text: Jan Hochadel, a Democrat, has represented District 13 in the Connecticut State Senate since January 4, 2023, and announced in December 2025 that she would not run for re-election in 2026.

paragraphs.text: She earned a degree in mechanical engineering from the University of New Haven and a master's degree in education from Sacred Heart University.
Her career includes work as an engineer, a teacher and an advocate, and she has served as a vice president of the American Federation of Teachers.
